attempts.summary: Created a 2.05 GiB LVM logical volume (datavg/datalv) backed by two loopback devices (no spare block device existed on node1), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, grew it online from an initial 1000M to 2100M (>=2GB) while mounted with data intact, made it persistent across reboot via a systemd oneshot service (lvm-backing-loop.service) that reattaches the loop devices before LVM/mount activation plus an /etc/fstab entry, and completed the mandatory single-node restart/recovery verification with a changed boot_id and confirmed post-reboot mount, LV size, and checksummed data integrity.
